async def judge(result, reader):
    record = (result.get('traffic', {}).get('scenario_records') or {}).get('U1', {})
    oid = str(record.get('id', '')).replace("'", "''")
    remaining = await reader.read_sql("SELECT json_build_object('rows', COUNT(*)) FROM public.reservation_item WHERE id='" + oid + "' AND deleted_at IS NULL")
    ok = record.get('created') == 200 and record.get('deleted') == 200 and remaining['rows'] == 0
    return {'checks': {'expired_manual_hold_released': bool(ok)}}
